summary: Shadow-gate checkpoints under risk_tolerance=off / autonomy disabled are advisory (pause_autonomy=False); PM counts only pause_autonomy open checkpoints so risk=off shadow previews no longer freeze orchestration forever (#645/#648/#660).
migration_impact: Existing pending shadow-deploy checkpoints created under risk=off may still have pause_autonomy=true; cancel them once (gh plate checkpoint decide <id> --decision cancel) or re-run gate after upgrade. New shadow gates at risk=off are advisory only.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to a release that includes this fix.
2. List open pause gates: gh plate checkpoint list (or inspect .agentic/checkpoints).
3. Cancel stale risk=off shadow-only pending checkpoints that should not freeze PM.
4. Confirm plate_pm_status open_checkpoints drops when only advisory gates remain.
agent_notes: create_checkpoint_for_shadow(risk=off or autonomy_enabled=False) records pending approval artifacts for feed/ledger but does not pause PM/AutonomyEngine. Live pause still applies when autonomy is enabled and risk > off. PM _count_open_checkpoints uses list_open_checkpoints (pause_autonomy filter).
